time.desc: The company submits a compliance plan to the exchange and hires a new audit agency to address delisting risks caused by the resignation of the auditor
The special committee announced its final investigation results, confirming that no management fraud or misconduct was found, and the company's stock price rebounded sharply.
The exchange officially approved the company's application for delaying the submission of financial reports and allowed the extension to maintain listing status until the specified date.
The company was officially removed from the major market index because its market capitalization fell below the inclusion criteria
The founder of the short-selling agency announced the dissolution of the agency, saying that the phased tasks have been completed
The company confirmed that it will submit a delayed annual report before the cutoff, directly mitigating the risk of forced delisting.
The company formally submitted overdue annual reports and quarterly reports to regulatory agencies, re-complied with listing application requirements, and concluded the delisting crisis case
The company disclosed that the internal control over financial reporting had major deficiencies and failed to operate effectively, and the stock price fell.
The company's co-founder and CEO was arrested on suspicion of violating export control regulations by smuggling high-end chips to certain countries.
Company director resigns, appoints acting chief compliance officer to strengthen compliance function
Independent directors launch an independent investigation into employees suspected of smuggling chips, without setting a timetable for completion
The board of directors announced the appointment of specific personnel to lead the internal investigation and the hiring of independent consultants to coordinate with the audit agency
Analysts raised their target prices significantly after the company submitted an extension filing
The company's decision to be removed from the main market index officially takes effect and the constituent stocks are replaced
The company's CEO gave out high forward revenue forecasts for the first time and also lowered the current year's revenue guidance.
The CEO of Company A publicly expressed confidence that it would submit overdue annual and quarterly reports before the cutoff.
After the results of the investigation by Company A's special committee were announced, the company's stock price soared by about 29% that day, closing at about 42 yuan.

The board of directors of Company A adopts the recommendation of the special committee, appoints a new chief accounting officer and approves the transition arrangements for the chief financial officer.
After Company A was approved by the exchange for an extension, the stock price of Region F surged by about 11.7% in night trading, with a cumulative increase of nearly 80% in the past month.
After Company A's extension was approved, one investment bank maintained a sell rating and another bank maintained a hold rating.
Company A announced that it received a letter from the exchange and was allowed to extend the period to meet the listing requirements to a specified date, temporarily avoiding the risk of delisting.
Company A files a Form C document indicating that its shares will continue to trade on the exchange under the supervision of a new external auditor
An analyst firm raised its price target to 60 Currency A after Company A filed for an extension.
After the news that Company A was removed from the major market index was announced, the stock price fell by approximately 8% that day.

Company A's special committee recommended the replacement of its chief financial officer during its investigation, and the company stated that the current chief financial officer will remain in office until a replacement is found.

The CEO of Company A predicted for the first time that revenue in fiscal year 2026 will reach 40 billion currency A, and at the same time lowered the revenue forecast for fiscal year 2025 to 23.5 billion to 25 billion currency A
After Company A updated its listing plan, its stock price soared by about 12% in early trading.
